evidence: Record exact page/control and Tab/Enter test result
user_impact: Keyboard-only users may be unable to reach or operate navigation if the test fails
recommended_fix: Use semantic links/buttons and ensure all menu actions are keyboard operable

evidence: Record input label/instruction observed and screenshot filename
user_impact: Screen-reader and other users may not understand the purpose or required format of a field
recommended_fix: Associate a visible label with each input and provide concise format instructions

evidence: Record image/icon and its accessible name from inspection
user_impact: Users who cannot see the image may miss information conveyed only visually
recommended_fix: Provide concise alt text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images

evidence: Record foreground/background colors and measured contrast ratio
user_impact: People with low vision may struggle to read low-contrast content
recommended_fix: Adjust text/background colors to meet WCAG contrast requirements

evidence: Record control and screenshot showing whether keyboard focus is visible
user_impact: Keyboard users may lose track of their current position
recommended_fix: Provide a clearly visible focus indicator that is not removed by CSS
